newsitem.title: FRANCE: UPS adds bigger aircraft on Paris-Rennes route.
newsitem.headline: UPS adds bigger aircraft on Paris-Rennes route.

text.p: United Parcel Service, said it had introduced a bigger aircraft on its weekday Paris/CDG-Rennes air cargo service.
"In the past fortnight, we have begun using a 5.5 tonne cargo capacity HS748 on the route which has replaced a two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 C," a UPS official told Reuters.
The HS748 is wet-leased from French airline, Air Littoral, the official said.
"A bigger aircraft has been made necessary on the route because of strong growth in our export volumes from western France," the official added.
The Paris-Rennes flight is one of five intra-France feeder services operated by UPS, the others each using Beechcrafts also wet-leased from Air Littoral.

In addition to the Paris-Rennes rotation, the feeder services also operate between CDG, UPS' principal French hub and Strasbourg while three flights operate between Lyon-Satolas and Nice, Bordeaux and Toulouse.
The five feeders flights synchronise with UPS's Boeing 727F services between Paris/CDG and Cologne and Lyon-Satolas and Cologne. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
